female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-children-details-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about their children fund faster.
female-children-details-faster.body: Pitches from women that specify the number or age of their children, or mention their education, are associated with increased funding speed.

female-spouse-income-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention using a spouse's income for loan repayment may fund faster.

female-hardworking-slower.body: Female borrowers who use the word 'hardworking' to describe themselves may fund more slowly.

female-brac-explanation-faster.body: Female borrowers who include a standardized explanation of the BRAC microfinance program may fund faster.

female-business-challenges-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly state a business challenge, such as slow sales, may fund faster.

female-large-scale-expansion-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention expanding their business to a large scale in the future may fund faster.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who include direct expressions of gratitude to lenders may fund more slowly.

female-smallholder-location-faster.body: Female borrowers who identify as a smallholder farmer from a specific location may fund faster.

female-external-family-location-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention external family locations may fund more slowly.

female-local-currency-slower.body: Female borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.

female-business-duration-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify the number of years their business has been operating or a start date may fund faster.

male-local-currency-slower.title: Male borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.
male-local-currency-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-explicit-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age in the pitch text may fund more slowly.

female-financial-barrier-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly mention limited financial resources as a barrier may fund more slowly.

female-family-details-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed descriptions of family size and children's education may fund more slowly.

female-widow-children-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention being a widow with children may fund more slowly.

female-environment-savings-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention saving money in conjunction with helping the environment may fund more slowly.

female-photo-id-faster.title: Female borrowers who include a note identifying the person in the photo may fund faster.

ag-input-specificity-faster.title: Pitches that list specific quantities or types of agricultural inputs predict faster funding regardless of gender.
